(c) In one of the streets of Viena, a blind beggar used to stand every evening and play upon the violin. (d) He felt so sad that he ceased playing. (e) He had played only a few notes, when a crowed of music-loving people began to gather, and so sweetly did he play that no one of the crowed moved away till music stopped.
